IPT.evidence_source: [/page/17/Text/5] Correlated t tests were employed to determine whether the S-C treatment was effective for subjects from the WL condition who received treatment after posttesting.
IPT.warning: The specific type of 'S-C treatment' is not fully described, but it is not explicitly named as IPT or interpersonal psychotherapy. 'BPS' is also mentioned, which typically refers to behavioral or problem-solving strategies, falling under CBT.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/17/Text/6] The difference between means of the CDS and CDRS-R failed to reach statistical significance, in part owing to the small sample size. The differences between pretreatment (posttesting) and posttreatment (follow-up assessment) means on the CDI were significant. Subjects also reported a significant improvement in generalized anxiety and self-concept.
dxgive.warning: The text mentions depression and anxiety symptoms but does not indicate that formal diagnostic criteria were assessed or required for entry.
